consequence.statement: Controller pods carry an additional `app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux` label; the release note describes this as a feature and states no failure or required action.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 manifests add the label `app.kubernetes.io/part-of: flux` to the controller pods.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the subject is a label on the controller pod template in the install manifests; no subject family (crd-field, helm-value, config-key, etc.) represents a pod label; applicability: evidence names no configuration that makes an environment exposed; it is a manifest-wide label addition with no subject family to anchor a predicate
